title: Maximum depth of a circuit list
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $c$ be a Boolean circuit tree on $n$ variables, and let $cs$ be a finite list of such trees. The maximum depth among the trees in the list formed by placing $c$ before $cs$ is the maximum of the depth of $c$ and the maximum depth among the trees in $cs$, with the maximum depth of an empty list taken to be $0$.
hypotheses_covered: $c$ is a Boolean circuit tree on $n$ variables
$cs$ is a finite list of Boolean circuit trees on $n$ variables
